preserved: Algorithm, reward, tensor, checkpoint and backend behavior; historical evidence; distinct residual Context phase1 runtime
forbidden: Branch creation, commit, push, training, simulator execution, checkpoint rewrite and method redesign

review.scope: Final maintainability, architecture, research-ML boundary and removal review

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: Canonical Hydra leaves own experiment values; unilab.training.offpolicy owns lifecycle; FADA source/planner_idm/target packages own stage APIs.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: The existing training CLI remains stable and compatibility exports preserve tested imports while implementation moves behind package APIs.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: Scripts import application and stage owners; no environment or backend module depends on scripts.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: Tracker, runner, playback and close paths remain cohesive in the offpolicy application package.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: The change is restricted to config ownership, orchestration ownership, FADA public namespaces, consumer migration, tests and current documentation.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Offline tests and config equivalence support structural preservation only; simulator behavior, training success and policy quality are explicitly not claimed.

dimensions.name: architecture-topology
dimensions.evidence: A 48-line CLI now delegates to application/factory/playback owners and command scripts use stage-specific FADA modules.

dimensions.name: ownership-convergence
dimensions.evidence: Twenty-five historical and active G1 SAC YAML leaves were reduced to eleven explicit generic, canonical and genuine specialization owners.

dimensions.name: caller-knowledge
dimensions.evidence: Callers choose canonical experiment identities and public stage APIs without knowing historical profile chains or runner construction details.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: No observation projection, privilege tensor, dtype, device, mask or shape logic changed.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Learners, losses, optimizers, replay semantics and update counts are unchanged.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: Checkpoint schemas and loaders are unchanged; canonical profile mapping and strict metadata behavior remain documented and tested.

dimensions.name: removal-reachability
dimensions.evidence: All active consumers were migrated; old-selector search finds only deletion assertions and immutable historical evidence or plans.

removed_dependency_edges: experiment task -> preceding historical experiment task
reduced_caller_knowledge: command scripts no longer import flat stage implementation modules
consolidated_lifecycle_owners: tracker, runner and playback orchestration moved behind the training package
clarified_semantic_owners: one canonical leaf owns each active experiment identity; target-domain YAML owns slope selection

file_metrics.before: 25 G1 SAC task YAML and 816 changed lines in the off-policy script
file_metrics.after: 11 G1 SAC task YAML and 48-line CLI with application/factory/playback owners

architecture_delta.rationale: Historical experiment order and lifecycle internals are no longer public knowledge required by active callers.

residual_risks: External commands that still name retired historical selectors require migration to the documented canonical profiles.
No authorized simulator or training run establishes runtime performance or policy quality for the refactored launch surface.
The full make test-all gate was not run because this task explicitly forbids simulator execution; the broad affected offline suite passed.
